text: Components of the same type (camera, motor, sensor, arm) expose the same API regardless of brand, so hardware can be swapped without rewriting code
quote: Every camera component in Viam exposes the same GetImage() method regardless of brand... That means you can swap hardware without rewriting your code.

text: Registry supplies hardware drivers; viam-server pulls the driver from the config and initializes it automatically
quote: Viam’s Registry provides drivers for your hardware, so you don’t need to implement one yourself. Specify your hardware model and connection details in the config, and viam-server pulls the driver from the Registry and initializes it automat

text: Search the Registry for hardware models by manufacturer or hardware type
quote: Search for the model that matches your hardware. Search by manufacturer or hardware type (for example, `webcam`, `viam:raspberry-pi:rpi5`, `viam:ufactory:xArm6`).

text: Pre-built modules are available, or you can build your own in any language
quote: Modular Components: Pre-built modules or build your own in any language

text: Write a driver module for unsupported hardware, and it then gets data capture, test panels, and SDK support like built-in components
quote: When no existing model supports your hardware, you write a driver module to add one. Once it exists, the hardware behaves like any built-in component. Data capture, test panels, and the SDKs work automatically.

text: SDKs in Python and Go for control logic, C++ for lower-level control, and TypeScript or Flutter for client apps
quote: Write your control logic in Python or Go, get lower-level control with C++, or build a client application with Typescript or Flutter.

text: Built-in NAT traversal connects to machines through firewalls and routers without port forwarding or VPN
quote: Built-in NAT traversal means you connect to any machine through firewalls and routers. No port forwarding, no networking configuration, no "it works on my machine" problems.

text: Run code from a local IDE against field hardware, and stream camera feeds, sensor data, and machine state live in the browser
quote: Write code in your local IDE and execute it against hardware in the field. Stream camera feeds, read sensor data, and visualize machine state in real-time from your browser.

text: Web interface test panels let you drive bases with the keyboard, move arms, and test components without deploying code
quote: Drive bases with keyboard controls, move arms to specific positions, or test components directly from Viam's web interface. Debug without deploying code.

text: Drive a mobile base remotely with a gamepad or joystick
quote: Base remote control: Drive a mobile base with an input controller like a gamepad or joystick

text: List machine resources and their health status, including reasons a resource is unhealthy or still configuring
quote: List the resources (`ResourceNames`) and their state (`GetMachineStatus`). A resource that is still configuring or unhealthy will fail every call; the status says why.

text: Data queues locally during outages or low bandwidth and syncs when connectivity returns, handling restarts and storage limits
quote: Data queues locally during network outages and in low-bandwidth environments, and syncs when connectivity returns. Viam handles restarts and storage constraints automatically.

text: Collect, store, and query sensor data and telemetry, with the built-in data manager capturing output to the cloud
quote: Data Management Collect, store, and query sensor data and telemetry

text: Export data in multiple formats, query tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL, and delete or tag all data matching a filter
quote: With it, you can export data in a variety of formats, query tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL, delete data, add or remove tags from all data that matches a given filter

text: Run SQL queries over tabular data from the CLI and save the results to an output file
quote: viam data query tabular sql --org-id=<org-id> --sql=<query> [--destination=<output path>]

text: Create and annotate datasets and train ML models in the cloud, or bring your own model
quote: Create and annotate datasets, and train ML models in your chosen architecture, all through the cloud. Or bring your own model.

text: Submit and manage ML training jobs through an ML Training client API
quote: ML Training Client API: Submit and manage ML training jobs running on Viam.

text: Machines automatically pull trained models and run inference locally; models can be versioned, staged, and rolled back
quote: Push trained models to the cloud. Machines pull them automatically and run inference locally. Version, stage, and roll back models just like code.

text: Over-the-air updates for software and ML models
quote: OTA updates for software and ML models

text: Canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning of deployments
quote: Canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning

text: Cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting
quote: Cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting

text: Manage organizations, locations, machines, permissions, and shared config fragments programmatically
quote: create and manage organizations, locations, and individual machines; manage permissions and authorization; create and manage fragments

text: Fleet management API lets you manage the fleet in code the same way as in the web UI
quote: The fleet management API allows you to manage your machine fleet with code the same way you can do in the web UI.

text: Machine API connects from any SDK to retrieve status and send commands remotely
quote: The machine API allows you to connect to your machine from within a supported Viam SDK, retrieve status information, and send commands remotely.

text: Machines can enforce per-resource, per-method permission restrictions in their config
quote: Machines can optionally enforce per-resource, per-method restrictions through `user_permissions` in the machine's JSON config

text: An AI agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine the same way a person or program can
quote: An AI agent with a shell or an SDK can operate a Viam machine the same way a person or a program can.

text: The CLI can call any API method a machine serves using JSON input and output, with no code required
quote: The CLI can call any API method a machine serves, with JSON in and JSON out. That makes it a complete way to operate a machine from a shell

text: The CLI provides shell tab completion for commands, subcommands, and flags
quote: The completion command outputs a shell completion script. Load the output in your shell to enable tab completion for commands, subcommands, and flag names.

text: Motion service plans and executes collision-checked motion to a goal pose using a declared frame system, obstacles, and constraints
quote: Plan motion through the motion service rather than commanding joints or poses directly. `Move` takes a goal pose in any frame, plus obstacles and constraints you declare, and returns collision-checked motion against the frame system’s geome

text: Compute and inspect an arm trajectory before the arm moves
quote: Use armplanning.PlanMotion to compute and inspect a trajectory before the arm moves, and learn how to get the same plan over the motion service API.

text: Logic modules can react to sensor data, coordinate multiple components, run continuous processes, and schedule actions
quote: Use a logic module when you need your machine to: React to sensor data... Coordinate multiple components... Run continuous processes... Schedule actions

text: Trigger an alert or actuator when a sensor reading crosses a threshold
quote: React to sensor data: trigger an alert or an actuator when a reading crosses a threshold. Coordinate multiple components: read from a camera and command an arm based on what the camera sees.

text: Inline modules can be written in a browser editor, with Viam managing source, builds, versioning, and deployment
quote: Inline modules let you write code directly in the Viam app's browser-based editor. Viam manages source code, builds, versioning, and deployment.

text: Connect a first machine: create it in the app, install viam-server on the device, and confirm it is online
quote: Connect your first machine to the Viam platform so you can configure, control, and monitor it from anywhere. You'll create a machine in the Viam app, install Viam on your compute device, and confirm it's online.

text: Discovery service detects available hardware on a machine and suggests component configurations
quote: Discovery: Detect available hardware on a machine and suggest component configurations

text: Control a motor's speed and direction in a few minutes
quote: Control a motor in 2 minutes: Use Viam to control a motor's speed and direction in just a few steps.

text: The setup wizard can run a machine in a cloud simulated environment before you have hardware
quote: If you don't have your hardware yet, the setup wizard can also run your machine in a simulated environment in the cloud, so you can start configuring and testing right away.

text: Vision service adds detection, classification, and segmentation to cameras
quote: Vision: Add computer vision capabilities like detection, classification, and segmentation to cameras

text: SDKs open WebRTC or gRPC transport, manage sessions for safety, and reconnect automatically when the network drops
quote: They open the transport (WebRTC where appropriate, gRPC otherwise), manage sessions for safety, and reconnect automatically when the network drops.

text: Host web apps on Viam with authentication and machine credentials injected automatically
quote: A web app hosted by Viam at `{name}_{namespace}.viamapplications.com`. Auth and machine credentials are injected automatically.

text: Build a monitoring dashboard for a system using the Teleop interface
quote: Build a monitoring dashboard for your inspection system using Viam's Teleop interface.

text: Run the server with a fake/dummy hardware configuration
quote: Example with a dummy configuration: `go run ./web/cmd/server -config etc/configs/fake.json`.

text: Free, self-paced courses, including Viam 101 taught in simulation with no hardware required
quote: Viam 101: Robotics Fundamentals Build a palletizing cell in simulation and learn the core concepts behind every Viam machine. 90 minutes · No hardware required

text: Free to start, with usage-based pricing after the first $5 per month
quote: Developer Platform ... Free to start, usage-based after first $5/month
